blocks.raw: # 🎉Feature Enhancements - We are making it better for you!!
blocks.text: 🎉Feature Enhancements - We are making it better for you!!

blocks.raw: #### Existing Feature - Currently, the PDT process includes several steps in regards to unlocking and locking accounts and as well the event notification not being delivered.
blocks.text: Existing Feature - Currently, the PDT process includes several steps in regards to unlocking and locking accounts and as well the event notification not being delivered.

blocks.raw: #### What is improving? - As part of the PDT enhancements, we will be improving automation for different parts of the current process. These enhancements include automatic unrestricted of accounts by end of day, automatic restriction of accounts in real-time and event notifications for both restriction and unrestricted.
